Aside.name: Aside
Aside.description: A semantic article aside with optional emphasis.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

title.description: An optional heading for the aside.

tone.description: The semantic emphasis of the aside.

Callout.name: Callout
Callout.description: A highlighted note, tip, warning, or caution.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

title.description: An optional heading for the aside.

tone.description: The semantic emphasis of the aside.

CardGrid.name: CardGrid
CardGrid.description: A deterministic grid of related navigation cards.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

items.description: A JSON array of titled cards.

Disclosure.name: Disclosure
Disclosure.description: Native expandable content for details and FAQs.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

Gallery.name: Gallery
Gallery.description: A responsive image gallery with captions and links.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

items.description: A JSON array of image, alt, caption, and link data.

presentation.description: grid lays the items out in columns; row sets 2–3 related items side by side, a horizontal snap rail on phones.

Steps.name: Steps
Steps.description: An ordered sequence of titled instructions.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

items.description: A JSON array of step titles and descriptions.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

items.description: A JSON array of tab labels and content.

label.description: An accessible label for the tab list.

CodeBlock.name: CodeBlock
CodeBlock.description: Source code rendered with Chakra CodeBlock, with adapter-driven syntax highlighting, filenames, line numbers, copying, and wrapping.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

colorScheme.description: The highlighting and semantic-token color scheme.

copy.description: Whether the copy action is displayed.

CodeGroup.name: CodeGroup
CodeGroup.description: A tabbed set of alternative code examples.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

items.description: A JSON array of labeled code examples.

label.description: An accessible label for the code tabs.

Diff.name: Diff
Diff.description: A semantic unified diff with additions and deletions.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

FileCard.name: FileCard
FileCard.description: A descriptive file link or download.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

download.description: Whether the link requests a download.

FileTree.name: FileTree
FileTree.description: A compact, semantic repository or project tree.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

items.description: A JSON array of paths, types, and optional metadata.

Terminal.name: Terminal
Terminal.description: A terminal command and its optional output.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

AudienceBoundary.name: AudienceBoundary
AudienceBoundary.description: An authored audience marker with a host-controlled visibility boundary.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

fallback.description: Fallback copy for an unauthorized viewer.
fallback.default: This section is available to a different audience.

showLabel.description: Whether the audience label is visible.

Comparison.name: Comparison
Comparison.description: An accessible feature and option comparison table.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

columns.description: A JSON array of compared option labels.

items.description: A JSON array of feature rows and values.

KeyTakeaway.name: KeyTakeaway
KeyTakeaway.description: A highlighted summary or list of essential points.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

eyebrow.description: A short label above the heading.

items.description: A JSON array of takeaway bullets.

Poll.name: Poll
Poll.description: An interactive reader poll whose submission handler is host-owned.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

options.description: A JSON array of stable option IDs and labels.

ProductCard.name: ProductCard
ProductCard.description: A product or recommendation card with explicit commercial linking.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

imageAlt.description: Alternative text for the product image.

PullQuote.name: PullQuote
PullQuote.description: A prominent quotation with optional attribution and citation.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

RelatedContent.name: RelatedContent
RelatedContent.description: A semantic list of related articles or resources.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

items.description: A JSON array of related content links.

SeriesNavigation.name: SeriesNavigation
SeriesNavigation.description: Previous and next navigation for a named article series.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

total.description: The number of articles in the series.

previous.description: The previous article title and URL.

next.description: The next article title and URL.

SponsorBlock.name: SponsorBlock
SponsorBlock.description: A clearly disclosed sponsor message and destination.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

logoAlt.description: Alternative text for the sponsor logo.

Stat.name: Stat
Stat.description: A prominent metric with context and trend.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

AppearsOn.name: AppearsOn
AppearsOn.description: A provenance-aware list of destinations where the post was syndicated.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

items.description: A JSON array of syndicated publication references.

label.description: The accessible heading for the destination list.

Audio.name: Audio
Audio.description: An accessible audio player with an optional caption.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

title.description: An accessible title for the recording.

caption.description: Visible supporting text below the player.

AuthorCard.name: AuthorCard
AuthorCard.description: A semantic author biography with portrait and profile links.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

role.description: The author role, title, or affiliation.

avatarAlt.description: Alternative text for the author portrait.

links.description: A JSON array of author links with label, href, and optional rel fields.

presentation.description: How much author detail is displayed.

CallToAction.name: CallToAction
CallToAction.description: A focused article callout with primary and secondary actions.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

eyebrow.description: A short label displayed above the heading.

example.jsx:
<CallToAction title="call to action example">
  Example content.
</CallToAction>

Carousel.name: Carousel
Carousel.description: A keyboard-operable image and content carousel.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

items.description: A JSON array of carousel items.

label.description: The accessible name for the carousel.

initialIndex.description: The initially visible zero-based item index.

presentation.description: slides shows one item with a position status; peek centres the current item with its neighbours in view, arrows only, and announces its caption. Neither advances on its own.

Chart.name: Chart
Chart.description: An accessible bar or line chart with optional data table.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

data.description: A JSON array of labeled data records.

series.description: A JSON array describing the values to graph.

title.description: The visible and accessible chart title.

description.description: A concise explanation of the chart.

showTable.description: Whether to show an accessible source-data table.

Figure.name: Figure
Figure.description: A responsive image with an optional caption and attribution.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

alt.description: Alternative text, or an explicitly empty value for a decorative image.

caption.description: Visible supporting text below the image.

creditHref.description: A URL for the image attribution.

href.description: An optional destination when the image is activated.

width.description: The intrinsic image width in pixels.

height.description: The intrinsic image height in pixels.

aspectRatio.description: A CSS aspect ratio such as 16 / 9.

objectFit.description: How the image fits its media frame.

objectPosition.description: The focal position within the media frame.

layout.description: The figure width relative to article content.

LinkPreview.name: LinkPreview
LinkPreview.description: A portable inline link, metadata card, native media player, or isolated rich embed.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

presentation.description: The requested link treatment. Auto chooses from resolved metadata.

images.description: How resolved preview images are displayed.

activation.description: Whether an external interactive embed waits for reader consent.

provider.description: A provider override for PostkitProvider, an editor, or a build-time resolver integration.

metadata.description: A normalized @postkit/unfurl result serialized as JSON.

imageAlt.description: Alternative text for the primary image override.

iframeTitle.description: An accessible title for a resolved iframe embed.

NewsletterSignup.name: NewsletterSignup
NewsletterSignup.description: A provider-agnostic newsletter form connected by PostkitProvider.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

list.description: A host-defined newsletter or audience identifier.

privacy.description: A short privacy or consent note.

ShareActions.name: ShareActions
ShareActions.description: Reader-initiated native, copy, email, and configured social sharing actions.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

title.description: The title included with the share.

text.description: Supporting text included with the share.

services.description: A JSON array of configured service identifiers.

label.description: The accessible heading for the actions.

SocialPost.name: SocialPost
SocialPost.description: A consistently styled social post card or consent-gated provider embed.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

resolution.description: Whether Postkit resolves the current post, renders frozen metadata, or falls back to live resolution when no snapshot exists.

snapshotInfo.description: Whether snapshot capture provenance is displayed in the rendered card.

branding.description: How strongly the service identity is displayed.

activation.description: Whether an interactive embed waits for consent.

metadata.description: A normalized social post, unfurl result, or versioned Postkit snapshot envelope.

showMetrics.description: Whether available engagement counts are shown.

iframeTitle.description: An accessible title for a provider iframe.

Video.name: Video
Video.description: A responsive HTML video player with caption support.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

title.description: An accessible title for the video.

caption.description: Visible supporting text below the player.

aspectRatio.description: A CSS aspect ratio such as 16 / 9.

captions.description: The captions track (a WebVTT file URL).

recommended.reason: Add a captions track (a WebVTT file), or mark the video decorative.

captionsLang.description: The language of the captions track, such as en.

duration.description: The running time, such as 0:24 or 1:02:03, shown with the caption.

decorative.description: Marks a video without speech or meaningful sound, such as a silent loop, so it needs no captions track.

Device.name: Device
Device.description: A screenshot in a plain iPhone, iPad or Mac frame drawn with CSS, with an optional caption.

size.description: The component density and type scale.

kind.description: The device frame: iphone (with a notch), ipad, or mac (a laptop with its base).

alt.description: Alternative text that describes what the screenshot shows.

caption.description: Visible supporting text below the device.

props.alt: The app’s home screen, listing three projects
props.caption: The companion app on iPhone.

example.jsx: <Device kind="iphone" src="/media/screenshot.png" alt="The app’s home screen, listing three projects" caption="The companion app on iPhone." />
example.directive: ::postkit-device{kind="iphone" src="/media/screenshot.png" alt="The app’s home screen, listing three projects" caption="The companion app on iPhone."}
